test_files: aptis-api/src/test/java/com/aptis/modules/examdelivery/service/ExamAttemptServiceTest.java (fixed constructor + extended: 6 new tests for enforceRetryGate)

RetryRequestTest.description: Static factory create(), approve(), reject(), consume() state machines; edge cases and invalid transitions

RetryRequestServiceTest.description: requestRetry() happy path and error paths (not-submitted, pending-block, approved-block, budget-exhausted at boundary); listPending() tenant filtering (HOST own exams, GRADER org-assigned, unknown role sees nothing); approve() and reject() with 404 for unauthorized (not 403)

ExamAttemptServiceTest.description: Fixed constructor call (added RetryRequestRepository mock); new enforceRetryGate tests: PENDING blocks with ACCESS_DENIED, APPROVED consumes and allows, REJECTED/CONSUMED/none allow without repo save, non-NOT_STARTED skips gate

notes: All 56 tests run successfully with zero failures.

RetryRequestTest (domain): Tests static factory with timestamp validation, state machine transitions (PENDING→APPROVED→CONSUMED, PENDING→REJECTED), error-case throws for invalid state transitions, and end-to-end flows.

RetryRequestServiceTest (service): Comprehensive coverage of 4 public methods—requestRetry() tests attempt-submitted gating, existing-request blocking (PENDING/APPROVED), and budget exhaustion at exact boundary (>= maxRetryCount); listPending() tests HOST-only, GRADER-org, and unknown-role access control; approve()/reject() test 404 for both not-found and unauthorized (tenant/role mismatch), ensuring no information disclosure.

ExamAttemptServiceTest: Constructor fix adds RetryRequestRepository @Mock and passes to service. New 6 tests cover enforceRetryGate's 3 main branches—PENDING request blocks heartbeat with ACCESS_DENIED, APPROVED request is consumed exactly once and heartbeat proceeds, REJECTED/CONSUMED/absent requests allow heartbeat without save. Verified that non-NOT_STARTED attempts skip the gate entirely.

Security-critical assertion: approve()/reject() return RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND (404) for both 'request not found' and 'tenant mismatch' cases, preventing an attacker from confirming request existence via different error codes.
Boundary condition tested: attemptsSoFar >= maxRetryCount (e.g., 2 attempts allowed, 2 so far = exhausted; 2 allowed, 1 so far = available).
All existing ExamAttemptServiceTest assertions remain unchanged in behavior; only the constructor call was fixed to accommodate the new RetryRequestRepository parameter.
